visual_system.quality_bar: distinct silhouette, physically plausible volume, clean premium materials, readable at small gift-gallery size
visual_system.animation_rule: Each gift must have its own authored motion choreography, timing, particles, sound cue and end state; no shared generic fall animation as the primary effect.
visual_system.technical_target: authored 3D asset (glTF 2.0 or equivalent) plus optimized runtime animation; SVG is preview art only, never a 3D completion claim

gifts.name: Resonanzkern
gifts.silhouette: A suspended faceted core held inside three offset precision hoops; no heart, star or crown outline.

animation.hero: core emits a concentric pressure wave through the hoops
animation.outro: the hoops fold into a compact floating seal

gifts.name: Fluxweber
gifts.silhouette: Two broad metallic ribbons weave through one another into a self-supporting knot, then separate without forming a bow.

animation.hero: one continuous over-under weave closes in mid-air
animation.outro: the weave resolves into two orbiting bands

gifts.name: Echo-Prisma
gifts.silhouette: A tall asymmetrical prism with a hollow acoustic chamber and visible internal facets.

animation.hero: a visible light pulse refracts into three internal echoes
animation.outro: echoes converge into one stable beam

gifts.name: Impulsbrunnen
gifts.silhouette: A levitating metal droplet feeds a closed loop of liquid-light channels; no fountain bowl.

animation.hero: fluid splits into four streams and reconnects above the droplet
animation.outro: loop drains upward into a hovering bead

gifts.name: Prismensaat
gifts.silhouette: A compact faceted seed-shell with six unequal shutters, not a flower or jewel-heart.

animation.intro: shell turns slowly with six seams lighting
animation.hero: shutters open in a staggered mechanical iris
animation.outro: interior light condenses into a small floating point

gifts.name: Gyrokompass
gifts.silhouette: A precision navigation instrument with three differently shaped gimbals and a suspended directional needle.

animation.intro: outer gimbal starts, inner gimbals lag
animation.hero: all axes precess and the needle locks to the viewer
animation.outro: gimbals brake independently into a quiet hover

gifts.name: Lichtarchiv
gifts.silhouette: A vertical stack of offset translucent data plates, each with a different cut-out geometry.

animation.hero: plates fan open to reveal a travelling light trace
animation.outro: the stack closes in reverse order

gifts.name: Graviturm
gifts.silhouette: Five non-identical architectural modules float in a vertical balance with visible magnetic gaps.

animation.intro: modules rise from below at different speeds
animation.hero: the stack tilts and counterbalances without touching
animation.outro: modules settle into a stable suspended column

gifts.name: Zeitspule
gifts.silhouette: A compact open-frame spool carrying one continuous luminous filament through a changing path.

animation.hero: spool accelerates while the filament draws a three-dimensional helix
animation.outro: helix contracts into the spool's central axis

gifts.name: Nexus-Siegel
gifts.silhouette: An original interlocking three-part mechanical glyph with no familiar crown, shield, badge or star contour.

animation.intro: three pieces approach from separate planes
animation.hero: pieces interlock with a precise quarter-turn and illuminate the seams
animation.outro: the assembled glyph rotates once and holds

gifts.name: Vektorbrücke
gifts.silhouette: Two separated anchor forms are connected by a flexible luminous bridge that bends through space.

animation.hero: a light bridge grows between them and carries a travelling wave
animation.outro: the bridge folds into a compact arc between anchors

gifts.name: Auroramatrix
gifts.silhouette: A dense but legible volumetric lattice of curved filaments around an empty central volume; not a galaxy or explosion.

animation.intro: filaments trace a sparse three-dimensional cage
animation.hero: the lattice braids into a shifting multi-layer volume with parallax
animation.outro: the volume contracts to a single luminous node and fades
